def count_Substrings(s: str) -> int:
    n = len(s)
    count = 0
    # Convert string to list of ints for faster access
    digits = [int(c) for c in s]
    
    # For each starting position
    for i in range(n):
        current_sum = 0
        # Extend substring to the right
        for j in range(i, n):
            current_sum += digits[j]
            length = j - i + 1
            if current_sum == length:
                count += 1
            # Optional early break if sum already exceeds max possible length
            # (not strictly necessary but can speed up)
            if current_sum > n:
                break
    return count
